system.description:
Starting at 6th level, your pact with the Reaper becomes symbiotic. Now instead of you siphoning off power for your own benefit, the Reaper has taken note of what you are doing and demands payment for its shared abilities. You can invoke this Domain ability, spending 1 Charge, marking a creature you can see within 60 feet of you as Gravetouched for the next minute or until it dies. While Gravetouched the creature is Cursed as if under the effects of your Curse of The Reaper (You still select a Hex effect). Marking another creature with Curse of the Reaper does not end this Gravetouched effect.

When you deal [Weapon Damage] or damage with jutsu with the Grim prefix to a Gravetouched creature you apply one of the following additional effects based on the Hex affecting them.

Vitality Hex. All willing creatures within 20 feet of you regain hit points equal to your Channeled Healing bonus instead of a single one.

Tributing Hex. The affected creatures increases the cost of their next jutsu by an amount equal to your Channeled healing Bonus before the beginning of your next turn.

Withering Hex. The affected creatures’ penalties apply to jutsu you cast as well.

| Reapers Arsenal – Curse of the Reaper (Cursed) / Curse of the Reaper is treated as a Mental Condition. / A Cursed creature suffers the following Hex effects of your choice when marked. This cannot be changed, for its duration, unless the creature is marked again later. / Vitality Hex. A creature marked with Vitality Hex has their lifeforce siphoned when they take necrotic damage. Once per turn, when a cursed creature takes Necrotic damage, you or an allied creature within 20 feet of you gains temporary hit points equal to your Channeled Healing bonus. / Tributing Hex. A creature marked with Tributing Hex has their Stamina siphoned when they take necrotic damage. When a cursed creature takes Necrotic damage, they also take Chakra damage equal to your Channeled Healing bonus and Once per turn, when you deal Chakra damage to a creature, you or an allied creature within 20 feet of you gains temporary chakra points equal to your Channeled Healing bonus. / Withering Hex. A creature marked with Withering Hex has their ability to resist jutsu hindered. The Cursed creature suffers a -1 penalty to saving throws against jutsu and effects that creatures other than yourself would inflict upon them. This penalty increases to -2 at 10th level and -3 at 18th level. |
